1879064188.name: Major Ballad - Resonance
1879064188.desc:
Heals a small area around your target while boosting your healing capability.

Ballads unlock Anthems and Codas while in combat.

<rgb=#00ffDD>While in Dissonance and Melody this skill will deal damage to a target instead of healing.</rgb>

1879089788.name: Stealth
1879089788.desc: A scattered people, the Rangers of the North are skilled at becoming unseen when they wish it.

1879157628.name: Berserker
1879157628.desc: A self buff that increases the damage of all auto-attacks, and Spammy AOE.

1879182844.name: Improved Rune-sign of Storm
1879182844.desc:
<rgb=#00FFDD>Affinity - Lightning
Affinity skills will change their effects when you use an elemental skill (frost, fire, lightning).</rgb>

A Rune-sign will not only inspire, but infuses an ally with elemental powers.

1879198332.name: Friend of Small Hunters (Grey Lynx)
1879198332.desc: Summons a lynx companion.\n\nThe lynx is a stealthy hunter.

1879208700.name: Summerfest Horse
1879208700.desc: A horse from the Summer Festival.

1879214588.name: Conviction
1879214588.desc: Boosts your defences and heals nearby allies.\n\n<rgb=#FF7700>Using will restore this skill to Battle Memory.</rgb>

1879219452.name: Improved Sustaining Bolt
1879219452.desc: The appropriate words may lessen the strain of exertion, enabling a Rune-keeper to sustain their powers for a longer time.  Grants bonus Power if at 9 Battle Attunement.

1879221500.name: Yule Festival Frosty Pony
1879221500.desc: A pony from the Yule Festival.

1879230332.name: Agonizing Maul
1879230332.desc: You tear into your enemy with sharp claws, drawing fresh blood.\n\n   <rgb=#00FFDD>Increased damage when attacking from behind</rgb>

1879240700.name: Swift Cut
1879240700.desc: A swift slice against an opponent dealing a little damage up front with a hefty bleed to follow.\n\n<rgb=#FF7700>Increases Fervour by 1</rgb>

1879244412.name: Resounding Challenge
1879244412.desc: Your challenge echoes in the ears of your foes.\n\n<rgb=#FF7700>Using will restore this skill to Battle Memory.</rgb>

1879248380.name: Noble Arrow - Fire
1879248380.desc: The Noble Arrow of Fire, once launched, will seek to injure your foe with critical intent.

1879256956.name: Blind Bet
1879256956.desc: After a Critical hit, make an attack that rolls a Blue gamble on you, improving your effectiveness in combat.

1879268476.name: Power of the Stone
1879268476.desc: Call on the power of the Stone to freeze the land around you!

1879312764.name: Black Swan
1879312764.desc: Summons a black swan to brighten your day.

1879319164.name: Sand-flies
1879319164.desc: Summons some sand-flies to your side. They have taken an interest in you.

1879319932.name: Invigourate
1879319932.desc: You nurture your steed back to a battle-ready state, restoring its power over a short period of time.

1879341436.name: Frosty Kite
1879341436.desc: Brings out a frosty kite for you to fly!

1879342076.name: Muster in the Camp of the Host
1879342076.desc: Allows the Warden to travel to the Camp of the Host.

1879360380.name: Steed of Eldar Autumn
1879360380.desc: A horse from the Fall Festival.

1879390716.name: Steed of Summer's Night
1879390716.desc: A steed dressed to celebrate summer evenings.

1879412860.name: Steed of the Autumn Sage
1879412860.desc: A steed befitting the Leaf-turner themselves.

1879430268.name: Return to the Noble Gate
1879430268.desc: You're able to quickly return to the Noble Gate. This skill is easily interrupted.

1879449852.name: Vicious Claws: Hide (Dual)
1879449852.desc: A savage attack that deals damage to your enemy, interrupting their action.\n\nGenerates threat.

1879467260.name: Dramatic Flourish
1879467260.desc:
Make a dramatic and masterful stroke, inspiring your allies to fight with greater precision for a moment.

<rgb=#FF7700>Swordplay Finisher:
 Enables Re-centre.</rgb>

<rgb=#FF7700>This effect does not stack with a Captain's Master of War Critical Hit buff.</rgb>

1879489148.name: Shatter Arms
1879489148.desc: Your companion weakens their target's offence.

1879506556.name: Sorcerous Study III
1879506556.desc: Your study of ancient malefic powers allows you to maintain a third malevolent spell until the final word is spoken.\n\n<rgb=#00ffff>Prepared spells deal less initial damage.</rgb>

1879506684.name: Personal Maneouvre
1879506684.desc: This skill updates to reflect your personal maneouvre.

1879508732.name: Muster at Jiret-menêsh
1879508732.desc: Allows the Warden to travel to Jiret-menêsh in An Shêru in Mûr Ghala.

1879523196.name: The Effigy of The Forsaken Reaver
1879523196.desc: Summon an effigy of The Forsaken Reaver, doomed to die shortly after it appears.

1879527420.name: Jagged Metal Shard
1879527420.desc: Use the shard in a slashing attack, damaging the target and breaking Shield of Darkness. This power will also harm the user.
